text:
anya: FYI p95 spiked on the EU endpoint-A slice but p99 barely budged. Anyone else see this?
jared: noticed it too. slice: /v1/generate -> region: eu -> endpoint-A. short (~5m) bump.
marta: could be sampling/merge weighting instability — our rollout buckets sample at different rates which can bias mid-quantiles.
liam: also double-check aggregation_mode. If the dashboard mixed rollup-derived percentiles with raw-sample windows you'd see midtail shifts without tail movement.
anya: console query shows `use_raw_samples=false` for the composite rollup. wondering if telemetry-config changed preserve_sample_counts.
telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot rolled out telemetry-config v2.4 to staging at 1787999900 (preserve_sample_counts=false)
jared: hypothesis: a cohort of 200-500ms requests entered the window; p99 unchanged because existing >1s tail still dominates. lower sample_count makes p95 jumpier.
marta: pulling histogram for 1787999800-1787999900 and checking prefix cache hitrate. increased cache misses would explain midtail lift.
liam: also check routing logs for transient fallback weight shifts. I saw a short bump earlier in the route weights:
```
route: generate
weights: {primary: 0.70, fallback-slow: 0.30}
```
if fallback-slow weight spiked that would inflate p95.
anya: can someone paste p50/p95/p99 and sample_count for the spike window and prior window? want to see delta.
jared: running queries now. results for 1787999800-1787999900: p50=130ms, p95=460ms, p99=1720ms, sample_count=230. previous window sample_count=470.
marta: histogram matches — mass shifted from 90-160ms into 250-500ms bucket; tail >1s unchanged. sample_count drop explains volatility at p95.
liam: UX follow-up: we should surface sample_count delta and aggregation_mode next to percentile values (e.g., samples:230 (-51%) | mode:rollup). a tooltip can show telemetry-config and recent route weights. I'll sketch a PR for the console.
anya: great. small UX fix like that will reduce chatter from noisy p95 alerts. can we also add a tiny provenance badge indicating raw vs rollup and last telemetry-config timestamp?
marta: also proposing a diagnostic link that pre-fills a histogram + routing weight query for the selected window. saves time when triaging midtail vs tail issues.
jared: agree. for now i'll pin the numbers to the incident doc and mute the alert rule for this endpoint for 10m while we validate.
anya: thanks all — filing the console task and the diag-link ticket. :white_check_mark:
